meta.method: Pass 1: news-first sweep of wet-season months (Apr–Nov) using Task 26 outlets and qualifying rule. Pass 2 (slimmed 2026-10-18): death queries with no site filter; Oyan Dam / Ogun River / lagoon / water-release / Isheri-Ajegunle-Owode-Agboyi queries; Anadolu once per year; out-of-season Jan–Mar and Dec. Qualifying reports name a Lagos State place and a date, and describe water on streets or in homes. Quotes ≤25 words, verbatim, and taken only from that report's own URL. Dates, numbers and quotes are only those in the source. Areas left as named; not geocoded. Flood date is the flood day, not publication day.
notes: Thursday 29 Mar 2018: Vanguard/NAN — two male private-school students found floating in floodwater at Casso Bus Stop, Alagbado, after Thursday rain. Punch 31 Mar (not kept as a flood report) quotes police PRO Chike Oti: Olumide Olaegbe, 15, and Farouk Jagun, 16, of Bright Future Academy fell into a septic tank on Foursquare Street, Omikunle, Ijaiye, about 16:30 on 29 Mar. deaths on r2018-003 follows Vanguard's own attribution (unnamed witnesses); the septic-tank line is recorded here, not in that report's deaths field.
Saturday 10 Feb: Irepodun Street, Dopemu — rain-flood into homes after BRT drainage excavations on Lagos-Abeokuta Expressway blocked the channel. Out-of-season; pass 2.
BBC Pidgin 26 Feb: Igbo-Efon / Osapa London — water in houses after rain that fell around publication; date_confidence approx. Out-of-season; pass 2.
Itedo Grammar School, Lekki Phase 1: Cool FM tweet Wednesday 6 Jun showed water in classroom corridors. Punch does not name that day's rainfall as the cause.

Friday 7 Sep Ikorodu (Oke-Afa / Isawo Road) and Saturday 8 Sep Ibeju-Lekki are separate days. Arepo on the Agric-Isawo-Arepo road is named in the Ikorodu copy; Lagos areas kept as named (Isawo, Igbo Olomu).
Guardian 19 Sep photo caption: vehicles wading at Apongbon, Lagos Island, 'yesterday' = Tuesday 18 Sep. Body is a national disease piece; no named Apongbon cause.

Vanguard 31 Oct: Rasheed Makinde (Ifako-Ijaiye II) told the Assembly a recent rain-flood killed one person in his constituency. No dated street/home description. Excluded. Not treated as a flood death day.

Punch 28 Oct Agiliti/Ajegunle feature: shops submerged, canoes; no flood day dated. Retrospective 2019 Guardian copy saying Ogun-river communities flooded in 2018 is not a 2018 dated report. No contemporaneous Task 26 Oyan/Ogun overflow day kept.
Anadolu 2018 Lagos-byline hits are the national Niger-Benue disaster (Kogi, Niger, Delta, Anambra), not a Lagos street/home day. The six-dead Lagos Oyan piece is 23 Oct 2019.
Abeokuta 13 Jul Oyan-related deaths (Vanguard/The Nation) are Ogun State. Nursing mother/baby/boy drowning 16 Aug at Ilubirin is a boat capsize while fleeing officials, not a flood death.

April–July, November, January and December: no qualifying street/home day in Task 26 outlets besides the Feb–Mar pass-2 days. May 25 (Channels) and Oct 10 (Channels) had no matching Punch/Vanguard/Guardian same-day keep.
X accounts of LASEMA, Lagos MoE and NEMA: no dated 2018 flood posts reached.
TVC, Premium Times and Nairametrics: no qualifying 2018 Lagos street/home flood day found. Punch 7 Sep 'Flash flood takes over Lagos roads' had no readable body (headline only).

reports.impacts: Saturday early-morning downpour: flood took over homes at No. 4 Irepodun Street after a fence collapsed. Children carried to safety. Shops on Lagos-Abeokuta Expressway submerged (bags of beans, yam flour, rice). No death reported.
reports.quote: The residents of Irepodun Street in Dopemu area of Lagos wailed loudly as flood from Saturday’s early morning downpour took over their homes.
reports.cause_quote: the ongoing construction which blocked the original water channel, thereby diverting flood to a fence behind their house
reports.cause_who: Olaiya Oyewole-Musilu, resident, No. 4 Irepodun Street

reports.impacts: Rain that fell around publication: water filled houses at Igbo-Efon; residents hired pumps. Water covered gutters on Lekki-Epe Expressway; people built monkey bridges. Osapa London canal blocked by water hyacinth; nearby houses flooded. Cars spoiled; some houses rebuilt higher. No death reported.
reports.quote: For Igbo-Efon side for Lekki-Epe expressway, people don begin pump water comot for dia compound as water full dia house
reports.cause_quote: di main palava na di grass and sand wey don block canal and di fact say government neva complete di canal
reports.cause_who: Ike Onyenokwe, chairman, Osapa London residents association

areas: Casso Bus Stop, Lagos/Abeokuta Expressway, Alagbado
reports.impacts: Thursday afternoon heavy rain: heavy flooding. Two male students of a private secondary school found floating on water at Casso Bus Stop; okada riders took them to a private hospital, Brought In Dead. Relatives wailing at the hospital.
reports.quote: Two male students of a private secondary school were picked up dead in the flood after a heavy rain
reports.cause_quote: There was heavy rain in the area in the afternoon which resulted in heavy flooding.

deaths.quote: Two male students of a private secondary school were picked up dead in the flood after a heavy rain

reports.review_note: 2026-10-18 reviewer: deaths attributed only to unnamed witnesses (NAN via Vanguard); Lagos police PRO Chike Oti (Punch, 31 Mar 2018) says the two pupils fell into a septic tank at Omikunle, Ijaiye. who_reported set to null, so this single-outlet claim does not promote.

reports.impacts: Friday early-morning downpour lasting several hours: flooded streets in Ketu, Bariga and Ojota. Motorists parked or crawled; commuters trekked. Traffic gridlock. No death reported.
reports.quote: Residents of the affected areas of the commercial city woke up to flooded streets especially in areas like Ketu, Bariga and Ojota
reports.cause_quote: The flooding according to the residents is because of drainages blocked majorly with plastic wastes.

reports.impacts: Wednesday: Cool FM video showed water taking over classroom corridors at Itedo Grammar School, Lekki Phase 1; students sweeping water. No death reported.
reports.quote: The video showed the flooded school and students, who were trying to sweep away the water, that had taken over the corridors of their classrooms.

reports.impacts: Monday: heavy water covered streets in Jakande, Lekki after serious rain. Traffic as roads filled with water. No death reported.
reports.quote: Heavy water cover streets for Jakande area of Lekki, Lagos on Monday afta serious rain wey fall.
reports.cause_quote: Heavy water cover streets for Jakande area of Lekki, Lagos on Monday afta serious rain wey fall.

areas: Oke-Afa by Asolo Bus Stop, Isawo Road, Ikorodu
reports.impacts: Friday early-morning three-hour downpour: Agric-Isawo-Arepo Road impassable; Isawo, Igbo Olomu and Arepo cut off. Commuters waded; some paid N100–N150 to be carried across, including pregnant women. Fares rose (resident: N750 vs N200). No death reported.

reports.cause_quote: early morning three-hour downpour which had rendered the road leading to the area impassable

reports.impacts: Saturday early-morning downpour: roads and homes flooded in Ibeju-Lekki. Valuables worth millions of naira destroyed (Balogun). Hospitality and other businesses affected. No death reported.
reports.quote: the early morning downpour left several roads and homes in the area flooded
reports.cause_quote: flood caused by persistent rainfall, coupled with poor drainage facilities in the community

reports.impacts: Saturday early hours: persistent rainfall and poor drainage flooded roads and homes. Valuables worth millions of naira lost. No death reported.

reports.impacts: Tuesday (photo caption 'yesterday' on 19 Sep): vehicles wading through flood at Apongbon, Lagos Island. No Lagos death in this piece.
reports.quote: Vehicles wading through flood at Apongbon Area of Lagos Island …yesterday.

reports.impacts: Wednesday morning heavy downpour: major roads filled with flood in Surulere, Aguda, Adelabu and Berger. Residents of Surulere and Aguda woke to flooded homes and streets; cars struggling. Traffic; motorists stranded. No death reported.
reports.quote: Residents of Surulere, Aguda, woke up to flooded homes and streets and cars were seen struggling to pull through the flood.
reports.cause_quote: heavy traffic in the Berger axis due to the flooded road as the drainage was blocked with plastic wastage

reports.impacts: Rain Sunday night to Monday morning: flood at Aboru. Fences pulled down; Aboru Road filled with mud and garbage. Egbodhoroma: water to window level of a one-storey building, ground-floor tenants gone. Furniture shop materials, machines and generator destroyed (Gift Wejem). Residents still evacuating water at 11 a.m. No death reported.
reports.quote: the water spilled over to the window level of my one storey building and pulled down my fence
reports.cause_quote: The problem is flood and the increasing volume of water that is channeled here. The bridge we have here is not a bridge.
